### Key Performance Metrics (revenue_component_level_1)
- **In Quarter Yield**: New bookings/upsells recognized in current quarter - updates daily
- **Backdated**: Revenue adjustments from backdated bookings - updates daily
- **Operational CCSP**: Operational/consulting services revenue - updates daily
- **Firm**: Baseline contracted revenue - books mostly on day 1 of month
- These components are critical for QTD performance tracking and "How are we doing?" analysis
